standards.name: Operational Data Model (ODM)
standards.abstract: Operational Data Model (ODM) is an XML-based, vendor-neutral, platform-independent format produced and maintained by the Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) for exchanging and archiving clinical and translational research data, plus associated metadata, administrative/reference data, and audit information. The standard is used to represent case report form content and other study metadata in electronic data capture (EDC) systems and regulatory submissions. The seed material includes CDISC webpages describing ODM and an example ODM XML instance (ODM v1.3.2) showing explicit XML attributes and elements (e.g., FileType, FileOID, CreationDateTime, MetaDataVersion, CodeList and EnumeratedItem) that carry concrete data types and controlled values.

classification.rationale: The source material includes an explicit XML instance/schema (ODM v1.3.2) with named attributes and elements that function as concrete metadata fields (e.g., FileType, FileOID, CreationDateTime, MetaDataVersion attributes, CodeList DataType and EnumeratedItem CodedValue). These are field-level structures with types/values rather than prose instructions or ordered process steps, so the 'table' classification (a metadata table of named fields) best matches the source.

ODM.FileType.name: ODM FileType
ODM.FileType.descr: Type of the ODM file snapshot (attribute on the ODM root element).
ODM.FileType.evidence:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<ODM xmlns="http://www.cdisc.org/ns/odm/v1.3" ... FileType="Snapshot" FileOID="CDISC_CT.Glossary.2025-09-26" Granularity="Metadata" ...>

ODM.FileOID.descr: Unique identifier for the ODM file (FileOID attribute on the ODM root element).

ODM.CreationDateTime.name: CreationDateTime
ODM.CreationDateTime.descr: Creation timestamp of the ODM file (CreationDateTime attribute).

ODM.AsOfDateTime.name: AsOfDateTime
ODM.AsOfDateTime.descr: As-of timestamp for the content (AsOfDateTime attribute on the ODM root element).

ODM.ODMVersion.name: ODMVersion
ODM.ODMVersion.descr: Version of the ODM specification used (ODMVersion attribute).

ODM.SourceSystemVersion.descr: Version of the source system (SourceSystemVersion attribute).

standards.notes: Extracted fields are taken from an ODM v1.3.2 XML instance included in the seed materials. The source pages also describe ODM conceptually; the XML instance supplies concrete named attributes/elements and example values that justify treating the standard as a field-level metadata model (table).
